name: Idle Management & Screen Locker
shortDesc: Monitors user inactivity, dims displays, suspends system, and presents secure lockscreen.
detailedDesc: Coordinates security and power conservation when stepping away from your machine.

phase.title: Desktop Shell & Core Plumbings
phase.description: Status bars, launchers, notification systems, on-screen displays, and wallpaper managers.

packages.name: hypridle + hyprlock (Recommended)
packages.description: Modern, GPU-accelerated lockscreen with Kawase background blur, dynamic time widgets, and fast input handling, paired with hypridle daemon.
cons: Requires Hyprland or wlroots compositor supporting session-lock

packages.name: swayidle + swaylock-effects
packages.description: Classic Swaylock fork with added desktop screenshot blurring, fade-in animations, and grace periods.

packages.name: gtklock
packages.description: GTK3-based lockscreen utility with module extensions for music player controls and power buttons.
